brief:
Egypt's Ministry of Education has incorporated a photograph of Palestinian child Muhammad al-Durrah into the national baccalaureate curriculum, Shehab Wire reported. The decision comes 26 years after al-Durrah's death, which was documented on camera and broadcast to audiences worldwide. The inclusion is designed to preserve the historical record of the slain child within Egypt's formal educational framework for secondary students.

The move returns al-Durrah to prominence through state-mandated schooling. His image has become a widely recognized emblem in Palestinian collective memory and historical documentation since his death during the opening period of the second intifada. The curriculum addition reflects efforts to maintain awareness of the incident among new generations of Egyptian students.
